[[File:Fertile Soil icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Fertile Soil''' is a [[Lunar spells|Lunar spell]] that can treat any targeted [[Farming/Patch locations|farming patch]] with [[supercompost]]. Doing so grants 87 [[Magic]] [[experience]] and 18 [[Farming]] experience. As with all Lunar spells, completion of the [[Lunar Diplomacy]] [[quest]] is required to cast this spell.

Players who have read the [[ash covered tome]] can have the spell treat a patch with [[ultracompost]] instead by casting the spell while having two [[volcanic ash]] in their inventory, which it consumes. The ash covered tome can be purchased from [[Petrified Pete's Ore Shop]] for 40,000 [[Volcanic Mine]] reward points.

Just like using compost normally, the spell can be used on a patch before or after planting the seeds and at any growth stage.

Casting this spell on the [[Morytania]] [[herb patch]] is a requirement for the elite [[Morytania Diary]].

==Cost==
The two additional [[volcanic ash]] for upgrading to [[ultracompost]] add an additional {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Volcanic ash|2}}|c}} to the cost. The cost can be compared to the current costs of [[supercompost]] ({{Coins|{{GEP|Supercompost|1}}}}) or [[ultracompost]] ({{Coins|{{GEP|Ultracompost|1}}}}) on the [[Grand Exchange]].

== Trivia ==
*If used on a patch that is finished growing, the player will get a chatbox message saying, "''Composting it isn't going to make it any bigger."''
*If used on a [[compost bin]], the player will get a chatbox message saying, "''No, that would be silly.''"
*If used on anything other than a farming patch or compost bin, the player will say, "''Um... I don't want to fertilize that!''"
*If used on the [[barren patch]] in [[Etceteria]], the player will say, "''No, I think I'd better compost it the old-fashioned way.''"
